title: Anomalous metal containing 51 elements, including human DNA and plutonium
summary: Chris Bledsoe tells of Anomalous metal containing 51 elements, including human DNA and plutonium, about unspecified at unspecified, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

plain: A man named Chris Bledsoe, whose strange experiences have drawn outside interest, says someone told him about a piece of metal made of 51 elements, said to include human DNA and plutonium. According to what he was told, humans at the time could only blend about 15 elements, even in the most classified work. If true, the metal would be far beyond anything people knew how to make.
